description: Na₄Ga₃Si₃O₁₂I crystallizes in the cubic P̅43n space group. Na is bonded to three equivalent O and one I atom to form distorted NaIO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.33 Å. The Na-I bond length is 3.08 Å. Ga is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Ga-O bond lengths are 1.84 Å. Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. I is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent Na atoms.
